about_the_game:
AKUMA's BLOODRAIN

Blow up hordes of akumas/yokais that are attacking this small japanese village. All akumas on each wave should be killed before the time's up, the quicker the better.

Gameplay
  • Shooting: Blow up the akumas with the shotgun.
  • Slashing: Finish them quickly with your claws.
  • Move Fast: Dash and climb to reach your enemies.

Demo's Content
This demo is very simple, focused exclusively on gameplay (it doesn't have menus other then pause and title screen), just sit and play our single demonstration stage so you can taste how it feels to play our game! It also has a score system so you can keep track of how well you played!


Controls
  • Shoot: Mouse left button
  • Slash: Mouse right button
  • Dash: Shift
  • Jump: Spacebar
  • Movement: ASDW or Arrow Keys
PS.: The full game will have key rebinding. But you can't rebind them in this demo.

Message from developers
"We're brothers developing games, and Akuma is our retro shooter we designed to be bloody, challenging, and fun as hell!"
- Hugo and Igor, developers of Akuma's Bloodrain

Thank you for checking out our game! Give us feedback if possible, we'll love to hear what you have in mind! :)

content_descriptors.notes: All enemies are demons, and killing them spills a lot of blood. You can also slice them into pieces.
